product_catalog_desc: Create and manage master products: name, SKU, department, and status. Assign them to each branch when ready.
branch_catalog_desc: Adjust prices, stock, and status for each product in this branch. Activate or remove them when needed.
item_not_found_desc: The product you are looking for does not exist or was deleted.
name: Name
plu_min: PLU must be a positive number.
search_items: Search by name, SKU or description...
delta_hint: Use positive for entries and negative for exits.
sale_price_min: Sale price must be greater than or equal to 0.
cost_price_min: Cost price must be greater than or equal to 0.
stock_min: Stock must be greater than or equal to 0.
min_stock_min: Minimum stock must be greater than or equal to 0.
price_min: Price must be greater than or equal to 0.
cost_min: Cost must be greater than or equal to 0.
quantity_min: Quantity must be greater than or equal to 0.
assign_items_to_branch_desc: Select the branch where you want to assign the selected products.
no_branch_items: No products assigned to this branch.
confirm_delete_item: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}"? It will be removed from all branches.
confirm_remove_from_branch: Do you want to remove "{{name}}" from this branch?
taxes_assign_hint: Check the taxes that apply to this product and save.
no_active_rates: There are no active tax rates. Create them in the Taxes module.
config_global_hint: This branch uses the same taxes defined in the global catalog.
config_global_hint_modifiers: This branch uses the same modifiers defined in the global catalog.
config_custom_hint: Custom configuration for this branch (copied from global when enabled).
config_custom_hint_modifiers: Custom configuration for this branch (copied from global when enabled).
readonly_global: Read only: this configuration is edited in the global catalog.
deactivate_item_desc: It will be deactivated in all branches and will no longer be available for sale. You can reactivate it from this list.
branch_deactivate_desc: {{name}} will stop selling only in this branch. The global catalog is not affected and you can reactivate it.
branch_remove_desc: {{name}} will be removed from this branch. The product is not deleted from the global catalog.
inventory_use_ingredient_hint: Stocked and counted. Not sold: hidden from POS and Cluvi.
inventory_use_resale: Sold and stocked (resale or finished product)
inventory_use_resale_hint: Stocked, counted and sold. E.g. Coca-Cola.
inventory_use_menuDish_hint: Sold but has no stock: assembled on demand. E.g. burger, delivery.
base_unit_hint: All stock is stored in this unit. It cannot change once the product has movements.
packagings_empty: This product has no packaging yet.
inventory_recipe_ingredient: Has a recipe: it is a prep item. The recipe is used when producing it.
inventory_recipe_resale: Has a recipe: it is a finished product. The recipe is used when producing it; selling it deducts the product itself.
inventory_recipe_menuDish: Has a recipe: selling it deducts its ingredients.
recipe_desc_sold: This product has no stock of its own: when sold (order Ready or POS sale) these ingredients are deducted from the selling branch.
recipe_desc_produced: This product is stocked: selling it deducts the product itself. Its recipe is used when producing it.
recipe_yield_hint: How much one batch with these quantities makes. E.g. 45 buns. For a dish, usually 1.
recipe_search_ingredient: Search an ingredient by name or SKU to add it
recipe_no_candidates: No results. Only stocked products or products with a recipe are listed.
recipe_empty: This recipe has no ingredients yet.
recipe_cost_hint: Uses the average cost of each ingredient in the selected branch. Refreshes after saving.
recipe_delete_desc: Selling this product will no longer deduct ingredients.
recipe_delete_desc_produced: It can no longer be produced until it has a recipe again. Selling it still deducts the product itself.
packagings_desc_gram: How this product is bought or counted. E.g. "25 kg bag" contains 25000 g, so you can order "2 bags" and the system stores 50000 g. It never deducts anything by itself: it is only used when you choose it while typing a quantity.
packagings_desc_ml: How this product is bought or counted. E.g. "5 L jug" contains 5000 ml, so you can order "2 jugs" and the system stores 10000 ml. It never deducts anything by itself: it is only used when you choose it while typing a quantity.
packagings_desc_unit: How this product is bought or counted. E.g. "Case x24" contains 24 units, so you can order "2 cases" and the system stores 48 units. It never deducts anything by itself: it is only used when you choose it while typing a quantity.
sell_here_hint_sellable: In the catalog this product is sold. Turn it off to stop selling it at this branch: it leaves its POS and its Cluvi menu.
sell_here_hint_ingredient: In the catalog this is an ingredient (not sold). Turn it on to sell it only at this branch, e.g. the production center selling bread to the public. It shows in its POS and its Cluvi menu.
images_desc: Up to 5 photos. The first one is the main image: it is shown in the catalog and sent to Cluvi; WooCommerce receives all of them.
images_add_hint: Click or drop here. JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
images_delete_desc: It is removed from the product and from online stores on the next sync. This cannot be undone.
images_privacy_hint: Public images can be offered to other businesses that create a product with the same SKU (barcode). Mark a photo as private if you don't want to share it.
images_limit: A product can have up to {{max}} images.
images_error: The image could not be updated
images_load_error: The images could not be loaded. Close and open again to retry.
images_error_upload: The image could not be uploaded
images_error_unsupported: {{name}}: unsupported format. Use JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF.
images_error_too_large: {{name}}: file is too large (2 MB max; GIFs cannot be reduced).
images_desc_department: Up to 5 photos. The first one is the main image: it is shown in the list and sent to Cluvi; WooCommerce receives all of them.
images_delete_desc_department: It is removed from the department and from online stores on the next sync. This cannot be undone.
images_limit_department: A department can have up to {{max}} images.
suggest_found: We found this product in another business
suggest_desc: You can use its name and description to fill in the form.
suggest_desc_images_one: You can use its details and its image.
suggest_desc_images_other: You can use its details and its {{count}} images.
suggest_applied: We filled the empty fields with its details.
suggest_applied_images_one: We filled the empty fields; its image will be copied when the product is created.
suggest_applied_images_other: We filled the empty fields; its {{count}} images will be copied when the product is created.
suggest_images_error: The product was created, but the suggested images could not be copied
